title: Rudolf Hess's telepathy experiments and astrologically timed flight

tellings.quote: >> he believed he was in telepathic communication with his wife while he was in prison they ran telepathy experiments

plain: Rudolf Hess, Hitler's deputy who flew to Britain in 1941 on a flight said to have been timed by astrology, believed while in prison that he was in telepathic contact with his wife, and telepathy experiments were run. The author Peter Levenda tells Michels this as part of his own research, without naming a source, as a sign of how seriously some Nazi leaders took the occult.
